## 2. Secure Save-Card Page

**In simple words:** this is the safe web page the customer opens from the text link. They type their card into **Square's own secure box** (the salon never sees the card number), tick **I agree to the policy**, and tap Save.

Square keeps the card. We keep a record of **when they agreed** in a Google Sheet (proof if someone disputes a fee).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ idempotency_key: 'card-' + $json.c.slice(0, 20) + '-' + $json.token.slice(-16), source_id: $json.token, verification_token: $json.verificationToken || undefined, card: { customer_id: $json.c, cardholder_name: $json.name || undefined } }) }}

parameters.message: =Thanks! Your card is saved with {{ $('Config').first().json.salonName }}. Reply YES to confirm your booking.
